# HerSets

> HerSets is the digital notebook for beauty artists: an iPhone app that keeps every client's preferences, formulas, maps and visit history in one place. Built for lash, nail, hair, brow, esthetics and makeup artists. Made by OLROM LLC, California.

## Pricing
- Free: every feature except SMS reminders, free forever, for up to 10 clients (visit history and booking page).
- Basic: $8.99/month or $79.99/year. Unlimited clients, templates, template builder, booking page, Salon View.
- SMS Pro: $17.99/month or $159.99/year. Everything in Basic plus SMS appointment reminders.
- Cancel anytime in App Store subscription settings.
